Maya, a woman in her late twenties, South Asian, olive skin, no makeup, faint under-eye shadows, dark wavy hair in a messy bun with loose wisps. Same in every shot: oversized cobalt-blue crewneck sweatshirt, charcoal leggings, white sneakers, plain dark smartwatch on her left wrist with a matte black unlit face. Her hands are empty.

Look: wide-normal lens, camera fixed on sticks, no camera movement, one continuous shot, documentary realism, visible skin texture, fine grain. Muted grey and brick, Maya the only saturated colour. Heads in the middle third, top and bottom of frame kept clear.
Rules: no text, letters, numerals, signage, logos or lit screens anywhere in frame. Maya does not talk to anyone. Exactly five strangers, and nobody enters or leaves frame except Maya.
The same fixed camera, the same cobblestone street, the same overcast light, the same five people standing in the same positions around Maya, still talking at her all at once.
audio: the same dense unintelligible street murmur at the same level from the first frame to the last, many overlapping voices, traffic, no music, no drop in level, never silent.

Then she turns and walks out of frame left. The camera does not follow her and does not move.
The five stay exactly where they are and carry on arguing with each other over the empty space where she was standing, gesturing at nothing, none of them noticing she has gone. Nobody looks after her. Hold on them, still busy, still talking, to the last frame.
